scope: Official lazy-page composition and bounded bidirectional client history; no backend scheduling, provider or paid-cost changes.

owners.history: RoomTimelineSession in client-core; sole cursors/data window, read-only; no ACK/read/Task mutations
owners.scroll: Existing official MessageTimeline capture/restore/observer owner, guarded build adaptation only
owners.loading: Loom page composition using official MainLayout lazy/Suspense pattern

provenance.adoption: PanelFallback markup/classes reused; lazy page pattern structurally ported. Timeline remains native with explicit guarded local adaptation for overlapping window shifts. Frozen upstream file hashes unchanged.
localChanges: Lazy-load six Loom page adapters; delay initial Agent mount but retain editor after first visit; remove static search-overlay edge.
On simultaneous first/last changes restore surviving native anchor instead of re-centering initial focus.

Native anchor snapshot additionally records scrollTop; only full-window-shift restoration compensates WebKit intermediate scroll clamping. Truncated physical tail does not enable live-follow ResizeObserver behavior.

provenance.license: Apache-2.0; copyright notice in room-timeline.ts and full license in packages/client-core/licenses/matrix-Apache-2.0.txt
provenance.adoption: Direction-aware bounded-window design, locally implemented; no Matrix client/store/runtime dependency or byte-exact algorithm copy.
provenance.localChanges: Evict owned array items, not just indices; retain overlap/focus, bounded serialized bytes, explicit head/tail availability and paused historical refresh. Local fake tests use Loom cursors and messages/notices.

limits: 300 retained items, 2 MiB serialized item payload; one oversized item is retained whole. Not a browser heap or network-response byte ceiling.
No global virtualization replacement. Existing RoomSession event retention and canonical ledger unchanged.
Initial resource count/encoded size is observational, not a cold-cache latency improvement percentage. Shared chat dependencies still load.

50,000 logical rows use a fake paged client; browser workflow uses a temporary real Core with 600 additional fixture posts. No 50,000-row real-database benchmark, heap plateau or exhaustive image/keyboard layout acceptance claimed.
Workspace linked worktrees/nested repositories/Git writes/PDF-HTML rendering remain outside this batch.

redEvidence: Before implementation, unbounded history/paused refresh tests failed; lazy-page check failed against eager build; guarded adaptation missing-module test failed.
Oversized prepend dropped reading overlap before boundary pin correction.
WebKit forward anchor test exposed 2857px displacement before viewport-compensation fix; same assertions passed after.
